name: Malaya Music Fest 2025
location: Cove Manila, Okada Manila, Parañaque, Philippines
description: Malaya Music Fest celebrates 5 years of freedom and Filipino pride. Set in Cove Manila, it features big names like Ely Buendia, Kamikazee, Mayonnaise, and rising local acts in a two-day live event experience.

name: Kick Off Manila Music Fest 2025
description: Kick Off Manila showcases emerging and mainstream Filipino music artists across genres. The festival aims to support local talent and donate a portion of proceeds to local youth art programs.

name: Aurora Music Festival 2025
description: Held annually alongside a vibrant hot air balloon display, the Aurora Music Festival blends music, food, and art in a two-day cultural spectacle. Past headliners include Ben&Ben, December Avenue, and Adie.

name: &FRIENDS Festival 2025
description: A multi-genre music and culture festival featuring world-renowned DJs and artists like Zedd, Illenium, and bbno$, along with food stalls, cosplay showcases, and local art exhibitions.

name: RADFEST 2025
description: RADFEST is One Click Straight’s curated festival featuring alternative acts like Clara Benin, ena mori, Lola Amour, and more. A celebration of new music with surprise guests and collabs.

name: Live at The Cozy Cove
location: The Cozy Cove, 27 Leonard Wood Rd, Baguio City
description: A Baguio-based acoustic series featuring live performances from singer-songwriters and indie bands in an intimate cafe-bar setting. Known for its mountain chill vibes and curated lineups.

name: Live Music Nights
location: Hard Rock Cafe Manila, S Maison, Pasay City
description: Enjoy live classic rock, R&B, and soul hits while dining at Hard Rock Cafe Manila. Recent performers include Luke Mejares and acoustic bands playing '80s to 2000s throwbacks.

name: Live Acts @ 12 Monkeys
location: 12 Monkeys Music Hall & Pub, Estancia Mall, Capitol Commons, Pasig
genre: Mixed genres (OPM, R&B, reggae, alt rock)
description: 12 Monkeys is Metro Manila’s go-to live music lounge, with gigs by local favorites like Ebe Dancel, Brownman Revival, and Paolo Santos. Rotating performances every weekend.
